steps.title: Configure App Meta and Identity
steps.description: Establish metadata including package name com.homecontrol.app and app name Home Control

steps.title: Create Step Roadmap
steps.description: Configure the systematic build roadmaps for the home automation control system

steps.title: Set Up Android Build Configuration
steps.description: Configure build.gradle with proper compilation and execution details using AGP 8.3.2 and SDK 34

steps.title: Define Manifest Security and Components
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with application entry point, valid standard theme and system configurations

steps.title: Establish Color Palette
steps.description: Create the color scheme inside colors.xml for dark blues, security success greens, alert reds, and dashboard backgrounds

steps.title: Establish Typography and Strings
steps.description: Set primary app label definitions inside strings.xml for the smart home dashboard system

steps.title: Design Card Elements Style
steps.description: Create rounded rectangle layout wrappers inside card_bg.xml to host separate dashboard sensors/actuators widgets

steps.title: Design Navigation Button Elements Style
steps.description: Create primary button drawable style definitions inside button_bg.xml

steps.title: Design Secondary Button Elements Style
steps.description: Create secondary outline button drawable style definitions inside button_bg_secondary.xml

steps.title: Design Thermostat Circle Widget Style
steps.description: Create background radial shape inside circle_temp_bg.xml to display the interactive target climate temperature

steps.title: Implement Main Layout Interface XML
steps.description: Construct dashboard UI with climate, security camera, light levels, dynamic logs, and tab switcher UI items

steps.title: Implement Live Feed Visual Simulation
steps.description: Program custom self-contained CameraView.java drawing scanning matrix grids and dynamic video feed graphics using standard 2D canvas drawing

steps.title: Develop MainActivity Control Code
steps.description: Bind layout components, manage climate variables, switch states, slider progressions, dynamic status changes and log entries

steps.title: Validate Java 8 Code Syntax
steps.description: Review MainActivity.java and CameraView.java to guarantee pure Java 8 standard syntax compatible with our compilers

steps.title: Confirm AndroidManifest Setup
steps.description: Validate absolute xml package pointers, standard namespace properties and configuration structures

steps.title: Building Home Control
steps.description: Compile the smart home dashboard automation solution into the debug APK binary target structure
